title: haemocharis ovalis
intro: Haemocharis ovalis, commonly known as the Chinese lobelia or Indian tobacco, is a flowering plant native to China, India, and Southeast Asia. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce stress, anxiety, and insomnia, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Haemocharis ovalis include sedation, relaxation, and pain relief, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids. Additionally, it has been used to treat respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant properties.
